title: Relay Room
reference: repeat 11 { forward if on_switch { activate } if tile_is r { turn_left } if tile_is b { turn_right } }
hints: Coloured tiles mark the turns. Switches sit between them.
Each step: forward, activate if on a switch, turn left on red, turn right on blue. An if with no else is fine.
repeat 11 { forward if on_switch { activate } if tile_is r { turn_left } if tile_is b { turn_right } }
